In every slice the lungs are black with fine branching vessels, the heart and mediastinum are mid-gray, and the thoracic spine, ribs, sternum and the curved CT table line are visible. The upper two slices pass through the mediastinum and the hila, where dark air-filled central airways are seen; the lower two slices show a larger heart silhouette with vessels at the lower hila. Each slice carries burned-in text around the margins: a patient-name line, an age and sex marker, number strings, a date stamp, scan-technique and window text near the corners and a position marker. No arrows, panel letters or author annotations are visible. No focal lung opacity, nodule, large pleural effusion or pneumothorax is clearly evident by eye in these slices at this resolution.
